topic: The final episode twist that broke the internet before the internet existed
hook: This ending broke the internet — before the internet existed.
script: This ending broke the internet — before the internet existed. Neon Genesis Evangelion's 1996 finale was so abstract and divisive that it crashed fax machines — the era's communication tool. Hideaki Anno received death threats by post. Fans gathered outside Gainax's offices. It was the first fandom meltdown of the internet age — without the internet. The reaction was so extreme that the studio made a theatrical film remake just to provide a different ending. Follow for the moment anime fandom became something new.
